  "description": "The African Medical Centre of Excellence (AMCE) Abuja is a 500-bed specialty hospital offering world-class comprehensive diagnostics and treatment in oncology, cardiovascular, and haematological care, and general medical and surgical services, along with top notch research and education. The AMCE will provide exceptional care to people on the African continent, regardless of their financial means. Developed by the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) in clinical partnership with King&rsquo;s College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust., AMCE Abuja is the first of five centres planned for development in Africa.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Neurosurgeon&nbsp;

Job Location: Abuja, Nigeria
Employment Type: Full Time
Workplace Type: Onsite

Job Purpose


	The Neurosurgeon will be responsible for the diagnosis, surgical treatment, and comprehensive management of disorders affecting the central and peripheral nervous systems, including the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerves.
	This role requires a high level of expertise in performing complex cranial and spinal surgeries, such as tumour resections, cerebrovascular interventions, and spinal fusions.
	As a senior member of the medical team, the Neurosurgeon will be a leader in advancing the hospital&#39;s neurosurgical capabilities.
	This includes contributing to the development of clinical protocols, participating in quality improvement initiatives, and driving clinical research to improve patient outcomes.


Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities
Clinical Practice:


	Diagnose and surgically treat a wide range of neurosurgical conditions, including brain tumours, traumatic brain injuries, spinal disorders, cerebrovascular diseases, and functional disorders.
	Perform advanced surgical procedures, including craniotomies, neuroendoscopic surgeries, microdiscectomies, spinal fusions, and carotid endarterectomies.
	Utilise cutting-edge technology, such as intraoperative MRI, neuronavigation, and neurophysiological monitoring, to enhance surgical precision and patient safety.
	Conduct regular outpatient clinics for pre- and post-operative patient assessments and follow-up care.
	Provide emergency on-call services for acute neurosurgical presentations, including trauma and stroke.


Patient-Centred Care:


	Deliver empathetic, compassionate, and culturally competent care to patients and their families, often dealing with complex and life-altering diagnoses.
	Provide clear, thorough, and understandable explanations of diagnoses, treatment options, surgical procedures, and recovery expectations, ensuring informed consent.
	Ensure meticulous and timely documentation of patient records, complying with all ethical, legal, and hospital standards.


Team Collaboration:


	Participate in and often lead multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings to discuss and plan comprehensive treatment strategies with neurologists, neuroradiologists, neuro-oncologists, and rehabilitation specialists.
	Collaborate closely with radiologists to interpret complex imaging (MRI, CT, DSA) and plan image-guided interventions.
	Partner with oncologists to develop integrated treatment plans for patients requiring adjuvant chemo- or radiotherapy.
	Work alongside nursing, physiotherapy, and occupational therapy teams to optimise perioperative, post-operative, and long-term rehabilitative care.


Education, Leadership and Development:


	Supervise, mentor, and train junior doctors, residents, and medical students, fostering a culture of learning and clinical excellence.
	Lead training sessions and workshops on advancements in neurosurgical techniques, patient safety, and critical care management.
	Support and drive continuous professional development (CPD) initiatives within the department and hospital.
	Act as a clinical lead for research and innovation within the neurosciences service line.


Research and Innovation:


	Design, lead, and participate in clinical research projects to advance neurosurgical treatments, improve surgical outcomes, and develop innovative approaches to patient care.
	Publish findings in high-impact, peer-reviewed medical journals and present at both national and international professional conferences.
	Stay current with global advancements in neurosurgery, neuro-oncology, and neurocritical care, actively implementing evidence-based practices.


Compliance and Governance:


	Adhere to all hospital protocols, national healthcare regulations, and international standards of care, including those from the World Federation of Neurosurgical Societies (WFNS).
	Ensure strict compliance with infection control measures, patient safety guidelines, and risk management policies.
	Actively participate in clinical audits, peer reviews, and governance activities to uphold the highest standards of quality and safety within the department.


Qualifications


	MBBS or equivalent medical degree from a recognised institution.
	Minimum of 10 years of post-specialisation experience in neurosurgery, with a proven track record of independent practice in a high-volume, tertiary care setting.
	Fellowship in Neurosurgery from a recognised international board or college (e.g., FRCS(SN), EANS, or equivalent).
	Sub-specialty fellowship training in a specific area (e.g., cerebrovascular, neuro-oncology, spinal surgery, or paediatrics) is highly desirable.
	Valid medical licence to practice or eligibility for specialist registration in Nigeria.
	Demonstrated expertise in a broad spectrum of complex cranial and spinal procedures.
	Proven experience in leading and training multidisciplinary surgical teams and mentoring junior medical staff.
	Track record of developing clinical protocols, leading quality improvement initiatives, and participating in hospital governance committees.
	A strong portfolio of clinical research, including publications in peer-reviewed journals.&nbsp;

Neurosurgeon Job at African Medical Centre of Excellence (AMCE)




        
    

        
        The African Medical Centre of Excellence (AMCE) Abuja is a 500-bed specialty hospital offering world-class comprehensive diagnostics and treatment in oncology, cardiovascular, and haematological care, and general medical and surgical services, along with top notch research and education. The AMCE will provide exceptional care to people on the African continent, regardless of their financial means. Developed by the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) in clinical partnership with King’s College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust., AMCE Abuja is the first of five centres planned for development in Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Neurosurgeon 
     

            
    



Job Location: Abuja, Nigeria
Employment Type: Full Time
Workplace Type: Onsite

Job Purpose


	The Neurosurgeon will be responsible for the diagnosis, surgical treatment, and comprehensive management of disorders affecting the central and peripheral nervous systems, including the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerves.
	This role requires a high level of expertise in performing complex cranial and spinal surgeries, such as tumour resections, cerebrovascular interventions, and spinal fusions.
	As a senior member of the medical team, the Neurosurgeon will be a leader in advancing the hospital's neurosurgical capabilities.
	This includes contributing to the development of clinical protocols, participating in quality improvement initiatives, and driving clinical research to improve patient outcomes.


Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities
Clinical Practice:


	Diagnose and surgically treat a wide range of neurosurgical conditions, including brain tumours, traumatic brain injuries, spinal disorders, cerebrovascular diseases, and functional disorders.
	Perform advanced surgical procedures, including craniotomies, neuroendoscopic surgeries, microdiscectomies, spinal fusions, and carotid endarterectomies.
	Utilise cutting-edge technology, such as intraoperative MRI, neuronavigation, and neurophysiological monitoring, to enhance surgical precision and patient safety.
	Conduct regular outpatient clinics for pre- and post-operative patient assessments and follow-up care.
	Provide emergency on-call services for acute neurosurgical presentations, including trauma and stroke.


Patient-Centred Care:


	Deliver empathetic, compassionate, and culturally competent care to patients and their families, often dealing with complex and life-altering diagnoses.
	Provide clear, thorough, and understandable explanations of diagnoses, treatment options, surgical procedures, and recovery expectations, ensuring informed consent.
	Ensure meticulous and timely documentation of patient records, complying with all ethical, legal, and hospital standards.


Team Collaboration:


	Participate in and often lead multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings to discuss and plan comprehensive treatment strategies with neurologists, neuroradiologists, neuro-oncologists, and rehabilitation specialists.
	Collaborate closely with radiologists to interpret complex imaging (MRI, CT, DSA) and plan image-guided interventions.
	Partner with oncologists to develop integrated treatment plans for patients requiring adjuvant chemo- or radiotherapy.
	Work alongside nursing, physiotherapy, and occupational therapy teams to optimise perioperative, post-operative, and long-term rehabilitative care.


Education, Leadership and Development:


	Supervise, mentor, and train junior doctors, residents, and medical students, fostering a culture of learning and clinical excellence.
	Lead training sessions and workshops on advancements in neurosurgical techniques, patient safety, and critical care management.
	Support and drive continuous professional development (CPD) initiatives within the department and hospital.
	Act as a clinical lead for research and innovation within the neurosciences service line.


Research and Innovation:


	Design, lead, and participate in clinical research projects to advance neurosurgical treatments, improve surgical outcomes, and develop innovative approaches to patient care.
	Publish findings in high-impact, peer-reviewed medical journals and present at both national and international professional conferences.
	Stay current with global advancements in neurosurgery, neuro-oncology, and neurocritical care, actively implementing evidence-based practices.


Compliance and Governance:


	Adhere to all hospital protocols, national healthcare regulations, and international standards of care, including those from the World Federation of Neurosurgical Societies (WFNS).
	Ensure strict compliance with infection control measures, patient safety guidelines, and risk management policies.
	Actively participate in clinical audits, peer reviews, and governance activities to uphold the highest standards of quality and safety within the department.


Qualifications


	MBBS or equivalent medical degree from a recognised institution.
	Minimum of 10 years of post-specialisation experience in neurosurgery, with a proven track record of independent practice in a high-volume, tertiary care setting.
	Fellowship in Neurosurgery from a recognised international board or college (e.g., FRCS(SN), EANS, or equivalent).
	Sub-specialty fellowship training in a specific area (e.g., cerebrovascular, neuro-oncology, spinal surgery, or paediatrics) is highly desirable.
	Valid medical licence to practice or eligibility for specialist registration in Nigeria.
	Demonstrated expertise in a broad spectrum of complex cranial and spinal procedures.
	Proven experience in leading and training multidisciplinary surgical teams and mentoring junior medical staff.
	Track record of developing clinical protocols, leading quality improvement initiatives, and participating in hospital governance committees.
	A strong portfolio of clinical research, including publications in peer-reviewed journals.

Recovery Officer Job at Good Neighbours Microfinance Bank




        
    

        
        GN MFB has tirelessly set the pace for other Microfinance institutions; it achieves this through distinguished service quality, product functionality, and exceptional customer service.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Recovery Officer 

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Identify and contact customers with overdue payments via phone, email, and in-person visits to negotiate repayment plans and recover outstanding debts.
	Conduct asset seizures independently.
	Work with customers to develop feasible repayment plans that align with their financial situations while ensuring compliance with bank policies.
	Develop, implement, and manage effective recovery strategies for delinquent loans.
	Prepare regular reports on the status of overdue accounts, recovery progress, and any challenges faced.
	Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements in all recovery activities.
	React proactively to unhealthy and risky portfolios to prevent losses.
	Identify and analyze the portfolio to determine the root causes of default and propose the best method of recovery of the loan.
	Initiate demand and reminder letters to all defaulting customers and review all credit files for proper documentation and monitoring.
	Any other responsibilities assigned.


Requirement/Skills


	HND/B.Sc in Finance or a related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in debt recovery preferably within the microfinance sector.
	Strong negotiation, communication and time management skills.
	High level of integrity and ethical standards.
	Excellent knowledge of MS Office (especially Excel and Word)
	Familiarity with microfinance principles, practices and regulatory requirements.

  "title": "Digital Marketing Executive",
  "description": "Duotech HR Consulting - Our client is&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Digital Marketing Executive&nbsp;

Job Location: Maitama, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

About Role


	Our client seeks to engage a Digital Marketing Executive with strong content creation acumen to manage the company&#39;s digital presence, drive property visibility, and generate qualified leads through targeted online campaigns.


Core Responsibilities


	Plan, create, and publish content (video, graphics, copy) across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube
	Shoot and edit property tour videos, reels, and short-form content using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Adobe Rush
	Design marketing assets (flyers, brochures, social posts) using Canva or Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator
	Manage and optimize paid campaigns on Meta Business Suite (Facebook/Instagram Ads) and Google Ads

 Job Position: Digital Marketing Executive
